## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
AGENTS.md still tells contributors to run `make test`, which this pull request removes. Because AGENTS.md describes those commands as the only checks a change gets, fix this before merging.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates the README to use the new name. It also adds a Layout section to AGENTS.md that lists each file and the Makefile targets.

## Important
- AGENTS.md:24 — comments — Update the `make test` instruction to `make check` — After the rename at Makefile:6, following the instruction "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite." fails with "No rule to make target 'test'". Your new line AGENTS.md:10 says the Makefile defines only `check` and `lint`, so the guide now contradicts itself. — Contributors and agents who follow the guide cannot run the test suite, which AGENTS.md:26 calls one of the only checks a change gets.
